description: Consumer Affairs Authority - The Consumer Affairs Authority Order the Maximum Retail Price for Canned Fish with effect from 28th December 2024
reasoning: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail prices for specific types of canned fish, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves the exercise of statutory powers to create binding regulations that affect commercial activities, rather than being primarily about government personnel, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
